browse_groups.maintenance_rule: Preserve stable AL20 identities, documentary editions and full memberships. Organization does not award points or establish eligibility. Check current local strategy and criterion evidence before project assessment.
browse_groups.description: Read the selection gate, aid ceilings, April 2026 call and September verification guide as distinct parts of an evidence chain. At least 60/100 is required by the governing order, but a qualifying score alone does not establish admissibility or reserve a budget. Public programme cofinancing differs from applicant aid intensity. The call permits local strategy/proposal changes and temporary suspension, so its documentary deadline and the library’s February tables do not prove present availability or the latest applicable local rules.

browse_groups.label: Nature-credit roadmap · prospective
browse_groups.maintenance_rule: Distinguish prospective voluntary nature crediting, carbon units, grants and procurement. Do not claim current market readiness, a credit, revenue or eligibility from this dated roadmap. Preserve ecosystem-specific measurement and independent-verification requirements.
browse_groups.description: Read the proposed chain from a quality-assessed action to a demonstrated ecological outcome, then inspect integrity and monitoring. The Commission roadmap treats nature credits as a possible complement to public funding. It also explains why biodiversity can matter in dry ecosystems with limited extra carbon storage. Site-specific measures, independent roles, safeguards and usable market rules are still necessary. The recorded 2025–2027 actions are document-stated plans; current implementation, buyers and prices have not been verified.
